verdict.rationale: Vanta's own Trust Center docs say it shows 'live controls' alongside docs in a branded portal. That supports control status flowing from the platform rather than being updated by hand. Nothing in the evidence shows subprocessor lists or document renewals syncing automatically; TPRM vendor discovery is a separate capability and is not credited to the trust center. Missing for 10: automatic subprocessor list updates on the trust center, automated document renewal/expiry refresh, detail on how live control status syncs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the trust center stays current on its own — subprocessor lists, document renewals, and control status update from the platform, not by hand

citations.quote: Trust Center puts your docs, live controls, and AI-powered answers in one branded portal, and automates access approvals and NDAs so your team stays out of the loop.
